name: GLYPH
definition: Atomic EVA symbol produced by evaglyph.CollapseEVA's longest-first composite-collapsing table (cth/ckh/cph/cfh/iin/ain/ch/sh/ee/in -> one uppercase symbol; else one glyph per rune)
note: Same parser used by Task58/59/60/77/82b. ZL3b glyph inventory = 45 symbols, IT2a = 32 (transcription-notational difference; not itself evidence about Voynichese)

name: TOKEN
definition: One maximal whitespace-delimited field of the frozen canonical corpus file, i.e. internal/genericsegmentation.ReadCorpus's tokenization (identical to internal/fingerprintv2's corpus loader)
note: 39,380 ZL3b tokens (8,243 vocabulary types) / 37,945 IT2a tokens (8,069 vocabulary types); GRAMMAR_CORPUS_SPLIT_MANIFEST.json corpus_totals

name: COMPONENT
definition: A model-class-defined decomposition unit of a TOKEN's GLYPH sequence (e.g. fixed-width n-gram, induced segment, single GLYPH, slot-grammar constituent). Alphabet and boundaries are defined per model class in GRAMMAR_MODEL_REGISTRY.tsv; Task85 fixes no COMPONENT alphabet
semantic_assumption_excluded: component = morpheme is NOT assumed; any prefix/suffix/stem vocabulary a model class uses must be tagged "(formal, not semantic)"
note: Only M5 (component/rule formation grammar) makes COMPONENT explicit structure; M0-M4 do not decompose below GLYPH

name: POSITION
definition: Index of a GLYPH within a TOKEN (G1 scope), or index of a TOKEN within its CONTEXT window (G2 scope), or index of a TOKEN within a LINE (G3 scope, "position in physical line")
semantic_assumption_excluded: position = grammatical role is NOT assumed
note: Same POSITION name is reused at three scopes deliberately; the scope is always stated alongside it

name: CONTEXT
definition: The bounded window of preceding (and, only where the discovery protocol declares it legitimate, following) TOKENs available to G2, defined purely by TOKEN sequence order, without reference to LINE/PAGE/FOLIO boundaries
source: TOKEN sequence order in the canonical corpus
note: Window width is a G2 hyperparameter frozen in the Task86/87-style handoff, not chosen by Task85

name: STRUCTURAL_STATE
definition: Any G3 conditioning variable that has passed the GRAMMAR_F2_APPLICABILITY.tsv applicability audit: LINE position/boundary, LOCUS type, FOLIO identity, section, Currier language, recto/verso, local regime
source: internal/metadatavalidation.Align token-to-locus join (Folio, LineID, LocusID, LocusType, Variables[$L,$I])
note: Never includes a variable admitted only because it improves fit (task85 section 8)

name: LINE
definition: One physical manuscript line: the set of TOKENs sharing one (Folio, LineID) key produced by the frozen internal/metadatavalidation.Align token-level join
note: Join is token-level, not canonical-line-index equality: IT2a's 5215 raw IVTFF loci fold into 5207 physical LINEs because some loci are same-line continuation fragments (task85-analyze finding; task65's naive equal-line-count loader would silently mis-join IT2a)

name: LOCUS
definition: One IVTFF locus record (Locus.ID / Locus.Type: paragraph start, label, continuation, etc.)
semantic_assumption_excluded: locus type = syntactic category is NOT assumed
note: Sub-LINE granularity where the IVTFF transcription marks it

name: FOLIO
definition: One physical leaf: the union of its recto/verso (and, for foldouts, multi-part) pages. The atomic unit of GRAMMAR_CORPUS_SPLIT.tsv
semantic_assumption_excluded: folio = discourse unit is NOT assumed
note: 103 ZL3b leaves / 102 IT2a leaves (fRos foldout carries no separate verso side in this count)

name: SECTION
definition: IVTFF $I illustration-type code, labeled: Herbal, Biological, Cosmological, Pharmaceutical, Stars, Zodiac, Astronomical, Text
note: Per-page ($I is recorded per recto/verso side, not per leaf); a FOLIO's SECTION in the split is the token-count-weighted dominant value across its sides

name: CURRIER
definition: IVTFF $L language code (A/B): the two-valued "Currier's Language" field
semantic_assumption_excluded: currier = grammatical dialect is NOT assumed
note: NOT internal/metadatavalidation.TokenMetadata's own "Currier" field, which reads $C (a distinct hand-numbering variable) - task65's documented correction (research/phase1/local-regime-topology-analyze/main.go), reused verbatim by task85-analyze; task85 mandates $L throughout Line A
